component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.assets.delivery.types
component.documentation: A delivery package, MediaDelivery: a distributor's delivery of a localised version to a territory. A person files one, naming the version, the distributor and the territory, wherever they may add a document; the delivery listener decides its files by the version's rights policy, refuses it whole when any is outside its release window or its territory, and otherwise writes what was delivered, when and by whom. It records the files the version held, by their digests, and holds none of them; since 0.5.0, it holds each file the version's watermark marks for deliveries, marked for its distributor and naming its filer. No Versionable facet: a delivery is never checked in or restored.
